gaps.explanation: Statement (trimmed p5, governmental funds statement, Total column): total disbursements 884,604 include Debt service 'Bond issue costs' 605. The Building Fund budget schedule (trimmed p19, printed p41) prints 'Bond costs' (605) under OTHER FINANCING SOURCES (USES), not among disbursements (Total disbursements 164,185 = operating 35,750 + debt service 128,435); detail[] already has it as section other financing, 'Bond costs' -605. Gap 884,604 - 883,999 = 605 = this one classification difference (expenditure on the statement, other financing use on the schedule). Nothing missing.

Statement (trimmed p8, printed p12, Statement of Revenues, Expenditures, and Changes in Net Position - Modified Cash Basis - Proprietary Funds): Charges for services 171,413 (Water 110,936 + Sewer 60,477); 'Other income' 19,232 (Water 8,397 + Sewer 10,835) is printed under OTHER FINANCING SOURCES (USES) (JSON business_type.other_financing 19,232). The Water Fund (p22) and Sewer Fund (p23) budget schedules print those amounts among receipts: Water 119,333 = 110,936 + 8,397; Sewer 71,312 = 60,477 + 10,835; total 190,645. Gap 171,413 - 190,645 = -19,232 = Other income, a receipt on the schedules and an other financing source on the statement. Nothing missing or duplicated.
